nom: Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Lifting Face + Neck Cream

avis.titre: Waiting to see how it'll repair & lift
avis.texte: The face & neck feel soft with the serum and cream- using morning and night.
This cream is really good and is helping my neck look less wrinkled and smoother. I also use the wrinkle correcting serum on my neck.
I love this moisturizer and how it helps my skin feel moisturized and tightened at the same time. I will buy and continue to buy, using along with the eye cream.
For more than 40 years, I've been using Clinique products; I'm now 77 years old, and still VERY pleased with the results. THANK YOU Clinique for your caring efforts.

I've used many different products different brands and nothing compares to Clinique smart clinical repair, lifting face and neck cream after a month before the month was up I started noticing the softening of my forehead lines. Love this so much getting the rest of the set. Plus and also made my skin so much smoother.

Clinique smart clinical repair. Used it with clinique smart clinical repair serum. A terrible, terrible itchy outbreak. It arrived unseald, without a paper package. Used clinique products before, were ok. A pity to have wasted so much money. Tried to stop and used again. And again outbreak.

I started using this product about 3 months ago and I can already feel a difference along my jawbone area and neck. Unlike other Clinique products, this cream has a slight scent to it, not perfumed but noticeable.

Great for men too! I can feel this product working. The skin on my face and neck is definitely tighter and more firm. Less lined. Amazing array of peptides and other good for your skin ingredients. Get it and stick with it! You won't be sorry.

avis.titre: Great for improving facial skin firmness and reducing lines
avis.texte: I've used the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Lifting Face & Neck Cream for this past month on a daily basis before I go to bed. I've already noticed an improvement in my skin's elasticity and overall smoothness, especially around my forehead and jawline. Noticeably improves firmness with my dry skin, so I will keep using! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Very drying and not lifting.  Created more wrinkles.
avis.texte: This lotion has a very strange consistency. It looks like it would be very creamy. However when you try to transfer the lotion from the jar to your skin you really have to work to get anything on your finger. It just won't scoop out without a lot of effort. I've had to use my nail to scrape off some of the lotion. As you are applying it to your skin, it feels as though it is drying on contact. It doesn't make my skin feel moisturized at all. My skin actually feels very dry after using this product! I got this product specifically for my neck, which is mentioned in the product title. However It made my neck so dry that it created more lines and wrinkles than I previously had. I have no idea if it is firming and lifting. But anything that is creating more wrinkles is not something I need to be using! I will try to return.
I wear this every night to help my skin stay firm and not saggy.
I have been buying this product for a long time, this is defiantly my everyday moisturizer. I am over 50 years old and I recommend this product.
I like this cream. It's thick and tightens my skin. It also has a nice scent.

I like the protection, but my face looks shiny- almost greasy and I've reduced the amount of SMR 30 SPF to see if that helps. Don't seem to remember this issue with the SMR 15 SPF. I add some sun-kissed face gelee to the cream- just as I did with the 15SPF to give my face some color. Any suggestions? If I'm going to be outside for awhile, I use your PEP Start 50. I've used Clinique for over 40 years, and people always tell me they don't believe I am 71.

avis.titre: Firmer, Smoother Skin in Just Weeks
avis.texte: I'm really impressed with this cream! It feels rich but absorbs quickly, and after a couple of weeks, I noticed my skin looking firmer and more lifted—especially around my jawline and neck. It also smooths out fine lines without irritating my skin. Definitely worth it if you're looking for visible results.
I started using this about 3 weeks ago and I am already seeing a difference in my skin on my neck and face. I will continue to use.
I am very disappointed in this product. I wear sunscreen daily and was excited to try this. It is basically unusable as it leaves little white pills all over my face.

This product is worth it. It is super moisturizing and melts in your skin. At first I thought the cream would be too thick but i was wrong. You dont need a lot and my face is so soft after using it a few nights. I have noticed some difference already in my neck and face.

I have mature skin at 59. I started using this cream about 3 months ago. I only use this cream and the serum from this line, but I've noticed a significant difference in the firmness of my skin. I have weird skin. I had cystic acne when i was younger and now I'm dry most of the time. I was using Perricone MD but had used Clinique years ago. I was looking for something with a wow factor that was less pricey. I definitely found it in this cream! It's super creamy, doesn't take much product, absorbs like a dream. And fragrance free!

I tried this product and I do really like it. I saw immediate results in my neck. Less creapy in less than a week. I did not realize it had retinol in it and I am sensitive to that ingredient so I can not use it on my face. But I was amazed that it actually worked.

avis.titre: Doesn't soak into skin very well
avis.texte: I find I can only use this at night because it sloughs off so much if applying foundation on top in the morning. Wish I would have just gotten the new night mask.

I feel like I've tried hundreds of different moisturizers. Many sit on top of my skin or feel heavy especially once you add sunscreen on top. This product absorbs quickly and actually makes my skin feel and look plumped. It also feels cool which I like a lot and has a clean, non-offending scent. It's a thick cream that's soft & pillowy and improves my skin's overall appearance.

avis.titre: not as sculpting as the discontinued Uplifting cream
avis.texte: For years and years I used the Repairwear Uplifting firming cream for dry combination to combination oily. It was my holy grail...it lifted my cheek pads/dermal cushion, keeping me looking sculpted and chiseled. Once it was discontinued I began using this and gradually noticed my cheeks and jawline falling, slackening and looking more mudflap-ish. I so wish that Clinique would bring back the Uplifting cream. It was amazing and gave a very defined silhouette and contour to the face..
I started with the sample. I loved it. Very creamy. A little goes a long way.
A little goes a long way; not heavy and I am seeing fine lines get smoother. Recommend!!

I finally ran out of my repairwear laser focus night extra dry cream and tried this smart clinical repair rich cream but alas it's nothing like my old night cream. It literally dries on the skin and drags as you apply it. This drag doesn't work for fragile mature skin. I wish you'd bring back a night cream with at least the top 3 ingredients of repairwear laser focus night extra dry cream. I've used it or its predecessor for ~30 years and people constantly compliment my skin and think I'm 20 years younger. I attribute it to this cream which I wore both day and night.
This cream has given me good results. I highly recommend her.

I'm still using one jar and I'm loving it. Fine lines between my eyebrows are improving. Twice a day continuously for months already. Small application per use, a jar could last for more than three months. Great product and will keep this on stock.

I was concerned about the switch to a new line of creams as I've been using the old smart night cream for years as a night cream, but overall have been satisified with the change. I'm 29 and was recommended by an Ulta employee in the store the lifting face + neck cream. The cream is a completely new product. It is thicker, much firmer texture than the old one. It is also bright white. It does not have a noticeable fragrance. (The jar says fragrance free). I use it as a night cream and can definitely see and feel the difference in 'firmness' and 'lifting' in my neck; although I didn't think I really needed it and that wasn't why I used the original night cream. I have noticed some white heads in my forehead/T-Zone, but I tend to get them occasionally anyway so I can't blame the cream on it. After reading about the other variations, I wish I had the SPF version so I can try wearing it twice a day with my makeup over it. I'll be giving this one to my mom and trying the SPF one next. :)

avis.titre: A Skincare Marvel for Ageless Elegance
avis.texte: Clinique Smart Clinical Neck Cream Review Copilot Your everyday AI companion Invent a new gadget that mildly inconveniences the person using it Teach me a few breathing exercises that I can do anywhere to relax What are some ways to overcome procrastination Design a modern kitchen island that features a bold color and wood countertop Share some fascinating facts about ocean tides Compose a pop song about an astronaut returning to Earth SunoTerms | Privacy What are some of the best ways to save money What are some daily habits of successful people Help me find furniture for my small apartment Compose a rock song about the eternal battle of the sun and the moon SunoTerms | Privacy Hi Gina, see what's possible with Copilot in Edge Generate page summary Suggest questions about this page Copilot uses AI. Check for mistakes. Terms Privacy FAQs Use GPT-4 You write a 5 star review for clinique smart clinical neck cream Copilot Certainly! Here's a 5-star review for From the moment I introduced Clinique's Smart Clinical Repair Lifting Face + Neck Cream into my daily regimen, the transformation was undeniable. This luxurious cream has become the cornerstone of my skincare, delivering results that are nothing short of miraculous. The cream's potent formula visibly lifts and rejuvenates both my face and neck, leaving my skin feeling supple and firm. Lines and wrinkles that once seemed a permanent fixture on my landscape are now softened, reduced to mere whispers of their former selves. Wh

Unfortunately, didn't live up to expectations. Despite being marketed for various skin types, it proved problematic for my combination oily skin. Every time I used it, instead of addressing the first signs of aging, I found myself dealing with frequent breakouts and acne flare-ups. If you're looking to avoid breakouts and maintain a balanced complexion, I'd recommend exploring other options instead.

avis.titre: Looks like I've had a facelift after using for 3 months
avis.texte: This is returnef the plumpness to my cheeks has lifted my laugh lines and I don't look as sallow under my eyes. This cream is amazing I thought I needed a facelift but after using this clinically proven product were 100% of women saw results I'm in love. I've never had more compliments on my skin and I'm 62.
Been using new product for 3 weeks, so far not real happy also higher price .

I normally use the Turnaound Overnight creme and I really like it, but decided to try this beause of my age. I am not a fan. This feels heavy and dry. It does not make my face feel soft. I am going to try to return it.

This cream feels rich but not heavy, and it sinks in beautifully. My face felt noticeably firmer and smoother after a few uses. It felt like a luxurious hug for your skin, it is definitely a bit on the higher end for pricing, but if you want to improve those neck lines and texture it is well worth it!
This might be a great product for others, but my skin didn't do well with it. It made me break out, so I stopped use. I have extremely sensitive skin though so it might be great for someone else!
Very nice packaging, has make my skin feel so tight and moisturized! Definitely recommend buying these type of creams for women 25+. Smells great too!
Very effective and does what it says. It's a very thick texture which I love. It just has a bit of a weird smell though. If you can get past it it is an amazing product.

avis.titre: Good but don't need it yet
avis.texte: As someone in their early 20s, I don't need a lifting face and neck cream just yet. However, the cream is very moisturizing, non-irritating, and unscented. I think those looking for a lifting cream would greatly benefit from this.

avis.titre: Amazing product for anti aging and fine lines and wrinkles!
avis.texte: The Clinique smart clinical repair line is in my opinion the best line for anti aging, fine lines/wrinkles, texture and hydration. It's an all in one product that's amazing for fine lines and wrinkles! If your looking for an anti-aging product that has a lot of skin care benefits and looking to help decrease the look of fine lines and wrinkles this is an amazing product and one of the most popular in Clinique!

After using the Clinique Smart Clinical Repair cream everyday for about a month, I've definitely noticed a difference in my face. I feel like my face as a whole is less droopy and my skin is hydrated and happy.
Decently hydrating but didn't notice a significant difference Might be different for other people though, so I'd recommend trying it out yourself

My main concern right now is prevention. So far I've really been enjoying this moisturizer. My skin is smoother and bouncier. The lines on my neck seem less pronounced as well. The consistency is thick but once it's applied it's weightless on the skin
Love the texture of this! I think a full size container of this will last me a while as a little bit goes a long way! Leaves my skin feeling very moisturized!

This cream is very refreshing and makes my skin feel so soft! I would recommend this to anyone looking for a new face and neck cream. I think this is a good value because there is a lot of product in the container.

I didn't notice much of a difference with my skin, there's no scent. I'm not really sure about the price due to not buying it in store, I received it as a free sample for my review. It is a smooth cream which was nice and I didn't have any breakouts or reaction to this as I have sensitive skin.

I was very excited to try this and ended up disappointed. The scent is a bit off putting and the cream made my face very red. It does not feel very hydrating or moisturizing and my skin ended up feeling tight and like I still needed moisturizer. The packing is standard for Clinique, no issue there. I do not think I would buy this on my own

Beautiful texture, made my skin feel glowy and moisturized. I have sensitive skin and this felt nice! I already have a skin regiment so I wouldn't go out of my way to buy this product as of right now but I'm grateful to have had this sent to me to try.

The cream was extremely thick in the container. I was originally worried that it would be difficult to use, but it was a mousse like consistency that ended up sinking into the skin easily. I liked that there was no scent as well.

I really enjoy this cream! As you can see from the photos, the texture is pretty thick so I really like using it at night. I feel that my skin looks very supple. It's not scented and it's been a lovely addition to my night time skin care routine!

avis.titre: Amazing product and a good size
avis.texte: This is a very rich and hydrating moisturizer. The jar is quite a bit larger than I expected and a little goes a long way. There isn't any strong fragrances and the product does not leave your face feeling oily. I want to say I have noticed a difference in the fine lines in my face, I feel this moisturizer does a really great job of leaving your skin looking healthy and plump.
This product wasn't bad. I personally wouldn't purchase it with my own money, but it wasn't bad for free. It is moisturizing, but I found it to not be effect all day.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. The packaging feels nice and luxurious. Upon opening the jar, this face cream was thicker than one I've ever used before. I expected it to be hard to smooth into my skin, but was pleasantly surprised. The cream is thick but it spread nicely into my skin and left it feeling extremely hydrated. I have skin that is extremely dry in the winter, but well hydrated in the summer. It doesn't have a scent, which I also really like as I don't love heavily scented facial creams. As for the lifting property - I can't really speak on as I haven't been using the product long and I don't really have sagging skin at 30. Overall I would recommend this as a nice moisturizing lotion.

This is a wonderful face cream as it is so soft on my skin and the smell is really relaxing. I haven't seen any significant changes but I always get up with a nice and hydrated skin. I highly recommend this cream to anyone who is looking for an beautiful antiaging cream!

avis.titre: Left my skin glowy and bouncey!
avis.texte: Looooved this product. Sits so nicely on your skin as it soaks in and leaves you with an incredible glow and noticeable bounce. I would buy this product again

I don't usually like products with dimethicone but it's further down ingredient list on this one. It actually feels moisturizing. I did notice that after a shower, it makes my rosacea flare up but otherwise seems fine on my dry sensitive skin!
I love how the product worked to get rid of my fine lines on my neck, even after just using your it for only a week! It went on so smooth and I was able to use it everyday! ￼

I was really impressed with this product! I have dry skin, and it often gets worse in the winter, so I'm always looking for a product that will help with that. While I've tried many moisturizers for my face in the past, I have never tried one that works for both the face and neck. While I'm only 32 years old and don't have a ton of wrinkles yet, I did feel that after using this cream over time, my skin looked more plump and softened. I can't wait to see how this cream will help my face and neck look with even more time. I don't really have a ton of sagging skin since I'm still pretty young so I can't really answer to whether or not it worked with that. Overall, I think this is a really high-quality product but I would probably only recommend it for people in their 30s or older. I just don't think younger people will get much use out of it other than hydration. Still, it's a great cream and I highly recommend it if you are in need of a product like this ￼￼

Very hydrating, starting to see some of that firming after ~3 weeks of consistent use. The info card indicates a 12 week result period, but I already see the start of that process, which is promising. It glides on smoothly, and sinks in quickly without leaving a residue. Finally, I appreciate the smell - it's not perfumed or super offensive.

I love this cream. It is a very thick cream. I feel it has left my skin plump and very well hydrated after using it. I use it as an under eye cream as well and like the way it makes my under eyes look

I love this cream, is so moisturizing and perfect for dry skin. I suffer from eczema and this cream does not make it flare, is absolutely great. If you layer a ton of skincare products and then makeup it might not be the best for morning use but it's amazing for night use, I will definitely be re-purchasing another one.

I was initially excited to try this out for the claims that it is face and neck lifting. I am only 27 but like many of us who rely on our phones for work, I am more often looking down. Which has created a noticeable crease that I am not fond of. I've been using this more as a neck cream for that reason and have seen a slight improvement in fading my neck crease. It is a very lightweight cream so it's not optimal to use at night, I would wake up with dryer skin than usual. But is definitely a great option to use in the mornings as a base for your makeup.
Lovely hydrating moisturizer, skin looks plumped. Better suited for a day time moisturizer. Better for non acne prone skin. Live laugh love Clinique

I always love Clinique products, very good brand. With the neck cream I really like as well, the texture is very thick so I can tell how much it will held the skin. Love it. My mom will love it too < 3
Awesome product. It's not overly powerful with the fragrance and it makes my skin so soft. I would definitely buy it again. I also love that it comes in a glass container

So excited to get this cream. Makes my face feel super moisturized and hydrated. Doesn't have a bad smell either. goes on easily and you get plenty of product. Excited to see how this makes my skin feel after I add this to my regular skin care routine
I have neck fine lines, I only see a little improvement. The cream is very thick and smooth when applying on my skin. It doesn't feel heavy and sticky.
This moisturizer works amazing and you can see and feel it working instantly. It is high quality and worked great on my combination skin type. I most definitely recommend it.
Age prevention has been top of mind as I get older, glad to add this product to my rotation. Not only are our faces important, but all skin including the neck.
I've been using the Clinique cream for a couple of weeks now and notice my fine line around my temple is less visible. The one fine line near my eye is not visible. I highly recommend

I really enjoyed this product … enjoyed it so much it's gone!! I will say it's a bit thick, I don't like the feel of it under a day's full makeup. But this gives my skin so much by hydration, I love applying this as my last step of my nighttime skin routine.
I've loved using this moisturizer, it feels gentle on the skin. I have acne prone skin and it hasn't caused any breakouts. I've especially liked using this to moisturize my neck.

I was super excited to try this product. Full honesty, I am 21, so I do not have many problem areas on my face. However, there is this one area on my forehead that really bothers me—you can see a wrinkle when I talk and try to pose for a picture while smiling. From the perspective of having just one problem area, I was amazed at how this worked. Sometimes I'll have a reaction to a skincare product when I first use it, and I have to use it a few times to stop having a tingling sensation, but with this, I found it to be gentle right away, and I did not have to go through that awkward period of my skin getting used to it. After three weeks of use, I can still notice that wrinkle area, but it is significantly lighter and less noticeable than before I started using this. I know that with further, continued use, that the area will continue to go away. As a bonus, I am obsessed with chic and high-end looking packaging, so I was already a fan just based off of that. This is the cutest addition to a skincare area in your room. *** I did receive a free product in exchange for this review, but these thoughts are 100% my own.

First of all, I love how thick and moisturizing this product feels. I feel like it really does help make my face and neck feel more lifted and awake looking. I don't care for the smell at all but it doesn't bother me enough to not use it. I recommend this product.

Clinique has done it again. This lovely anti aging face and neck lift cream is the best new item ive tried in forever. I felt it lifting almost immediately! The bottle looks pretty and appealing as well. Very chic!

Was excited to try. But after opening and trying out for a while, I wasn't too thrilled about the product. It doesn't have a scent, and that's fine for me, but I didn't like the consistency. It has a squishy and bouncy feel to it and don't like how it felt on face. It didnt leave a hydrated feel on my face. I was excited to try because of the hyaluronic acid, jojoba oil and peptides it claims to have. But I was not satisfied. I'll pass on this.

I haven't used too many neck creams before but out of the ones I have tried this one I have actually noticed a difference before and after. Being in my late twenties it may not be necessary but I have seen noticeable changes in my jawline. Also, having dry skin it is very nourishing and easy to apply.

I had a random patch of dry skin on my neck and this cream took care of it. It wasn't going away with my usual products so I gave this a try and within days my skin was back to normal. It soaks right into the skin and leaves no residue.

avis.titre: It was ok, but not for me.
avis.texte: I received the💜Smart Clinical Repair™ Lifting Face + Neck Cream💜for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review! Thanks for the product💜∩^ω^∩💜 💜 What it is: A powerful face & neck cream visibly lifts skin & reduces lines + wrinkles for smoother, younger-looking skin. Plumps with instant and long-lasting hydration. Dermatologist tested. 🔑Ingredients & Benefits: 💜Multi-peptides: Help boost skin's natural collagen 💜Hyaluronic acid, Jojoba oil, & Shea butter: Helps hydrate to help visibly plump fine, dry lines ⚠️WARNING⚠️ This product can expose you to chemicals including Titanium dioxide, known to the State of California to cause Cancer How to use: Use morning & night on face + neck 💜 My experience: My first impressions of the product were, the cream doesn't feel nourishing for my combination skin. Despite this being a cream, it started to feel more like a balm after a while of me rubbing it onto my skin. I don't really recommend this cream to those who have really dry skin. I still haven't seen any changes in lifting or line reducing on my skin after 2+ weeks of using the cream, so it seems that I really do need to use it for at least 12 weeks. After I applied the product, I felt my face wasn't really moisturized but at the same time not dry. The cream didn't feel too greasy & heavy on my oily t-zone. It felt lightweight & very absorbent on my skin. The finishing of this product looks matte, feels dewy & non-sticky on my skin. A weird thing I don't get about

This product was much thicker than I expected, but that's not a bad thing! I wasn't able to see a visible difference using this cream but I haven't used it for very long. Either way it is moisturizing and very smooth to apply!

This cream delivers on its promise of lifting and firming, leaving my skin feeling noticeably smoother and more toned. I love how it targets both the face and neck. Plus, the texture is luxurious and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. Overall, I highly recommend this product for anyone looking to achieve a more youthful and rejuvenated appearance.

Having used this cream for several weeks now, I must say I'm impressed. The texture is luxurious and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling hydrated and rejuvenated. I've noticed a visible improvement in the firmness and elasticity of my skin, particularly in the neck area. While the price point is a bit higher, the results make it worth it!

I received this product in exchange for an honest review. I loved the packaging and how easy it was to pack into my toiletry kit. I also loved how light the moisturizer felt and how I didn't have the urge to wash my hands right after applying it. I am in my mid 20s so I am not sure how much this helped with lifting the face and neck but it definitely hydrated my skin and did not cause any skin irritation or breakouts. The product was really nice to use and I will continue to use it on my daily routine and see how long it takes before I notice a more significant different but I do enjoy the formula and texture of the moisturizer and the design of the bottle.

Clinique Smart Clinical Repair, Lifting Face and Neck Cream is a remarkable skincare gem that has truly transformed my aging skin. From the moment I started using it, I noticed a significant improvement in the firmness and elasticity of my face and neck. The luxurious formula feels incredibly nourishing and hydrating, leaving my skin looking radiant and youthful. I love how it targets wrinkles and fine lines, delivering visible results that make me feel more confident and beautiful. I highly recommend this cream to anyone looking for a potent solution to combat the signs of aging.

For context, I am 29 and have a combo, sensitive skin that is prone to breakouts. I use prescription retinoid, which makes my skin dry and sensitive. I have been using this product for about a month, both AM and PM. This cream feels very hydrating and nourishing. Not sure if I notice a plumping effect, but I enjoy the lasting hydration and how soft it makes my skin feel. The consistency is on a thicker, heavier side, but I do notice that it melts away and absorbs into the skin easily, without feeling heavy. I appreciate that it is not fragranced and safe for sensitive skin - it didn't break me out at all. The packaging feels heavy and expensive, which is a nice bonus. Overall, I did enjoy this product and would definitely recommend, especially to people with dry and sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Solid cream but led to some breakouts
avis.texte: I'm not necessarily the key demographic for this cream so I can't speak as well to the lifting aspect of it but it was very moisturizing! It went on well, had a nice "skincare" scent that wasn't too overpowering. It was also filled to the brim with product which is always a plus! The cream unfortunately led to some breakouts on my jaw line but my skin can be sensitive to moisturizers.

avis.titre: New era of De aging cream
avis.texte: This Clinique Smart Clinical Repair Lifting Face + Neck Cream is the new version of Anti Aging line. I like that the main ingredient is muti peptide instead of retinal which both helps minimize fine lines and smooth skin texture. But peptide is easier to use even for sensitive skin while retinal can irritate the skin easily. However I'm not a big fan of heavy cream texture so I use it on the neck only. It is preferred at nighttime.

I let me mom use this and she really loved it! As she ages she has been more into skincare! This was easy to use, blended well and felt great on her skin! She needs to use it long term to see a true difference
It seems like a good product. I like that it does not make your skin feel oily and weird. I have not been able to use it long enough to see any significant changes yet, but I will continue to use.

This is a thick, emollient cream that I find best for repairing my skin over night. It has no fragrance and kind of smells like sunscreen. That doesn't bother me though. It seems to do a great job moisturizing my skin and doesn't irritate it.
Obviously Influencer sent me this product, and I'm glad they did! Based on the results, the price point is great. So lightweight and very neutral smell.

The Clinique Smart Clinical Repair lifting face + neck cream is a rich white cream that helps moisturize and lift the skin. The cream had multi peptides and hyaluronic acid. I use this cream in the morning and at night for my face and neck. I like that the cream is thick and melts into the skin. The cream feels comfortable and helps keep my skin healthy.

After using this Clinical Repair Lifting Face and Neck Cream for a few weeks now i can see a little bit of a lift for sure in my neck. I would recommend this product. I like that it doesnt really have a scent and after putting it on it doesn't leave you feeling sticky it melts in!

avis.titre: This is a nice cream for flaky skin
avis.texte: I have very dry skin on my face and neck and this one is nice to relieve the flakiness I sometimes get throughout the day! It has a very thick texture, almost like a thick butter but it's not greasy which I appreciate. It doesn't have a smell that I can tell which is also a plus. I will continue to use.

Okay, Clinique is usually the last brand that i would choose when it comes to skin care. The only thing that was worth anyone time was the cleansing balm but even that was a little harsh for some peoples skin types. So when i got this to try out I was not excited and didn't have high expectations. I tried to hate this for a month! I compared it to my other HA+ and peptide products and well it held up well. I really liked this after using it. Did a see a "lifting effect"? no, i think i might have to use it longer but i felt like my skin looked more hydrated which is what you want! Pros: hydrating, good peptide HA+ product, easy to use, good for dry sensitive skin Cons: the container is big and bulky to travel with, also have to dip a nail or finger in to get product, no lifting effect after a month of use

I like the packaging of this, the jar feels heavy and luxurious. The cream is dense in the jar, and feels very smooth and creamy on the skin. It sinks in well, and leaves my skin feeling smooth and soft for hours. It has a very slight clean smell like a spa, which I love. I am looking forward to the results after using it awhile.

avis.titre: Probably awesome but a little greasy
avis.texte: This moisturizer promises some really awesome ingredients and I was so excited to try it! Unfortunately, I had a hard time getting past the somewhat greasy texture. It may be the perfect product for some but unfortunately it is not for me.

I wanted to really like this, and I'll probably use it up, but it's not my favorite. The cream is thick, and has a shimmer to it. There is a slight fragrance to it which I don't mind, but I generally steer clear of. I'll use it up due to its cost and the fact that it's nice texture.

Clinique smart clinical repair cream has become a great product to add to my nighttime, skincare routine. This product is truly fragrance free, just smells like lotion. It is thick and applies easily helping moisture absorption. I have noticed a difference in facial elasticity. Would recommend.

avis.titre: Wasn't my favorite, didn't work very well for me
avis.texte: Not quite sure the value for the money is worth it for this product, even though Influenster sent this for free. I did a before and after using this product for awhile and didn't see the biggest difference. It's hard to tell with the sleep lines in the after picture, but you can clearly see my lines are still very prominent. I probably won't be repurchasing.

avis.titre: Works great, don't like the glitter
avis.texte: I truly enjoyed the way this product worked and felt on my skin. My face and neck were so smooth it didn't leave me feeling sticky or gross which was nice. I also really liked that once it was worked in there was absolutely no scent!! The downfall to this product in my opinion is the glitter or shimmer that is in it. I don't understand why it would be in there at all. If they made a new version without the shimmer I would be all over it. The product is great, I just don't like pointless glitter.

I really had high hopes for this as Clinique is one of my favorite brands. Out of the things this product claims to do is to diminish the fine links and wrinkles but honestly I barely noticed any of that which is why I gave it 3/5 stars. I actually think they were more prominent on my forehead than before. I will say that the product left me with extremely soft and bouncy skin so I would use it solely for that reason. There was no heavy fragrance scent which I like in face products and even with sensitive skin I never broke out from the product. It is very jelly like in consistency so it is tough to get out of the container but I love that it is non- greasy and immediately absorbed into my skin so I could easily continue my face routine or put makeup over it. Overall a decent product. #incentivized

I have been using this face cream for a few weeks and have seen a noticeable difference in my skin. The cream is thick and feels luxurious. Right after applying, my skin feels tighter. My skin feels moisturized all day, but not oily or greasy.
Love a fragrance free moisturizer that can be used day or night. Good on it's on or under makeup. Hydrating but not too thick for my dry skin. Perfect for the winter while being good for aging.

this is such a rich hydrating moisturizer. i use it all over my face and neck and it helps smooth out my skin. i have some fine lines forming on my forehead from raising my eyebrows and this basically gets rid of it whenever i use it

This cream is great-feeling on the skin, and I very much appreciated that it didn't have an overpowering scent like a lot of anti- aging products. Would recommend adding this to your routine, especially for your neck, which is often neglected in skin care.
I absolutely love this product, it's so rich and creamy. It also does feel like it's tightening your neck, I would 100% recommend anything from Clinique they know skincare

This clinique smart clinical repair cream is a very nice hydrating cream, it leave a beautiful dewy finish. The formula is very nice & not thick, it definitely left my face feeling soft & glowing. I have sensitive skin and I didn't have any reaction or issues with this cream. In terms of anti-wrinkle properties I didn't notice anything drastic, I did notice a few small wrinkles that were less visible (I will add that they say to use the product for a couple months before you'll notice big changes). I'm going to continue using this product. It left my face feeling lifted & firmed and it did not leave my skin feeling tight or uncomfortable. It was a very hydrating cream. When it comes to smell, I didn't notice any fragrances, which is another plus. Overall, I think this a good product & recommend it. It left my face glowing & looking more tone & firm without leaving my skin feeling tight. I do like the texture & the finish, I definitely think it's a good cream.

I was glad I wasn't allergic. I tested this the full month and loved how hydrating the formula was. I have combo skin and it melted in just fine, it felt thick in my hands but as I massaged it onto my skin it just melted right in. I knocked a star just because I didn't notice much of a change. But u feel like I need to go out and buy a new cream to keep testing it out longer than just one month.
For using it this far I have seen slight differences but not long enough to see super noticeable differences. Definitely would try if you like this brand

I received this product via #voxbox and have been able to use it consistently for about 3 weeks. I gave it 3 stars because it's the first Clinique product to not cause a breakout on my face. However, for the price (and smell), it wouldn't have been my first pick had I gone to purchase it myself. #clinique #liftingcream #voxbox

i love this face and neck cream! it is so moisturizing and makes your skin feel great. after using this religiously 2 times a day i have definitely noticed a difference in my skin. my skin is more firm and lifted. great product!!

I received this free to try and really liked it. It has a mousse like texture and goes on very easily. You don't need a lot and it feels very moisturizing. I can't be sure about whether it delivers on a lot of firmness but am very happy with the moisturizing piece!!
I love it. Was in 10 minutes of putting on. You can feel the skin tightening. The smell is a bit unique. But not too strong. Easy to apply. Another great product from Clinique
